title: Samara Blaze
style: smooth electronic R&B, 102 BPM, coastal real estate energy, confidence and vision theme, NZ/AU male vocal smooth and assured, aspirational lifestyle, Nicaraguan coast theme, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Nicaraguan coastline — Pacific side
Samara on the wave — in the tide
Icon Realty — property with soul
San Juan del Sur — making it whole

[CHORUS]
Samara Blaze — she runs the coast
Samara Blaze — she does the most
Samara Blaze — real estate raw
Samara Blaze — she knows the law

[VERSE 2]
Blaze holding down the local ground
Medwyn working copper underground
Two people — two purposes — one signal
SJDS — the community pinnacle

[BRIDGE — chill, spoken]
This is for the people who found it.
The ones who stayed.
The ones who built something
on the Pacific side.

[FINAL CHORUS]
Samara Blaze — Nicaragua
Samara Blaze — para todos
Samara Blaze — the coast is real
Samara Blaze — Blaze and Samara feel

[OUTRO]
San Juan del Sur.
Still here.
Still building.
